measurement: CPU replay and exact integer count validation only
clock: CPU only; 1350 MHz target not measured

conventions.matrix: dense contractions: 2 FLOPs per multiply-accumulate (including initial add)
conventions.shape: captured tensor logical shape; includes model-side bucketing, not original input work
conventions.tile32: round effective M,N,K to 32; exact conditional arithmetic, not issued program work
conventions.sfpu: symbolic evaluations only; no exp/sqrt/etc FLOP coefficients
conventions.instructions: not counted; require compiled kernels and dynamic paths

aggregation: Inventory occurrences only. Captures overlap. No cross-capture FLOP sum or fold total.

fixture_provenance.scope: Raw graph only. CPU replay does not repeat or certify device timing. Historical graphs do not establish current-default coverage.
